### Emma - Budget Planner Tracker {#review-app-2}

   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Jun 15, 2026 - Jul 28, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Affionie_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "I cancelled the annual subscription last year and they just attempted to charge me £42 again despite having uninstalled the app and it not showing up in my subscriptions. They saved my card info and circumvented Apple’s purchase regulations, and the process to cancel the subscription in the app is extremely predatory and drawn out. DO NOT USE THIS APP.             2. _fizzgp2233_, Jul 23, 2026, 2/5: "This app used to be worth downloading until they hid all their features behind a paywall, I’m downloading the app to help with my finances, not to add more pressure and money into the mix."

         **Review examples:**

So, either make the icons same or stop putting on ads whos gonna pay for an app that confuses what you're paying for."
